prompt_text:
IMAGE EDIT ONLY — do not redraw or reinterpret the character. The supplied edit canvas contains four identical copies of the canonical right-facing dwarf miner. Keep the canvas, four-Frame row, logical grid, magenta Gutters, and character construction.

Create a four-Frame in-place WALK by changing only the legs and boots below the locked upper-body region. The canonical rectangle x=0..15, y=1..18 must remain exact Cell-for-Cell RGBA in each Frame, with only one whole-region vertical offset of -1, 0, or +1 Cell. Do not repaint, restyle, simplify, rescale, or add detail to the helmet, lamp, face, black eye, beard, torso, belt, buckle, gloves, arms, or shoulder pickaxe.

Frame 0: contact pose, front boot forward and rear boot back.
Frame 1: down pose, both knees compressed, upper-body lock shifted down by one Cell.
Frame 2: passing pose, legs crossing cleanly with separate boot masses.
Frame 3: up pose, opposite leg advancing, upper-body lock shifted up by one Cell.

The dwarf remains horizontally registered; runtime translates the actor. Legs and boots remain separable from each other and the torso. Frame 3 leads cleanly to Frame 0. The stride reads heavy and deliberate, not like a tall human jog.

Exact 16×24 logical Frames rendered as crisp flat square Cells; four Frames; two full magenta #FF00FF logical Gutter Cells; one horizontal row; no margins, labels, extra rows, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, or dithering. Preserve canonical subject colors in locked Cells; newly edited subject Cells use only the first-room Master Palette and never transport magenta.

Intended read: the exact idle dwarf has started walking; only his lower-body pose and one-Cell vertical weight shift changed.
